title: Al-Jami' al-Saghir
author: al-shaybani
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: A compact collection of rulings that al-Shaybani transmits from Abu Hanifa through Abu Yusuf, arranged by the books of the law. It is one of the zahir al-riwaya texts and was memorised and commented on as a summary of the school's settled doctrine.
historicalContext: Tradition holds that Abu Yusuf asked al-Shaybani to write down what he had transmitted from Abu Hanifa, and that the result was this book. Its brevity made it a teaching text, and later Hanafi commentators, al-Sarakhsi among them, wrote commentaries on it.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
